verses.text: Every high priest is chosen from among the people. He is given the job of serving God for them, offering gifts and sacrifices for sins.
He can be gentle with people who do not know better and who go the wrong way, because he himself is weak too.
That is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.
No one takes this honour for himself. God must call him, just as he called Aaron.
In the same way, Christ did not give himself the glory of becoming High Priest. God said to him, "You are my Son. Today I have become your Father."
And in another place God says, "You are a priest forever, in the line of Melchizedek."
While Jesus lived on earth, he prayed and begged God with loud cries and tears. God was able to save him from death, and God heard him because he honoured God so deeply.
Even though he was God's Son, he learned to obey through what he suffered.
After he was made perfect, he became the source of salvation that lasts forever for everyone who obeys him.
And God named him a High Priest in the line of Melchizedek.
We have a lot to say about this, but it is hard to explain, because you have become slow to listen.
By now you should be teachers. Instead, you need someone to teach you the very first lessons about God's message again. You need milk, not solid food.
Anyone who lives on milk is still a baby, and does not yet understand the teaching about what is right.
But solid food is for people who are grown up. They have trained themselves by practice to know the difference between good and evil.
